intro: This page covers O’Hare’s official Main Garage and Lots B and C, the Terminal 5 garage and Lot D, Economy Lots F, G, and H, Premier Parking, and Reserved Parking. Rates were copied from the Chicago Department of Aviation’s official parking pages on November 20, 2026. Below those are nine off-airport options: six independent lots in Schiller Park and Franklin Park, a Rosemont hotel lot booked through The Parking Spot, and two hotels whose own pages describe a park-and-fly offer. We chose operators that publish a street address on their own pages; this is a sample, not every lot near the airport. O’Hare sends all off-airport shuttles to the Terminal 2 Arrivals curb, and several lots say they run 24/7, while the Marriott partner lot’s shuttle stops at 11 PM, so check before a late flight. Rates are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

officialLots.heightRestriction: Main garage 6'6"; Lot B 9'0"; Lot C 8'5"
officialLots.name: Main Garage daily parking (Levels 2–6) and Lots B and C
officialLots.area: Main garage and adjacent outdoor Lots B and C, next to domestic Terminals 1, 2, and 3

hours.notes: The official O’Hare parking pages do not publish lot opening hours. Hourly parking is on Level 1 of the main garage.

officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-20. The official page does not recommend the main garage for extended overnight stays because its daily rates are higher than the Economy lots. Payments are made to the cashier on exit; the official page lists cash and major credit cards. Rates include all taxes. Parking over 30 days must be arranged in advance with the Parking Garage Office at (773) 686-7530 or the vehicle may be towed.
officialLots.visitNotes: Note which level you parked on before leaving the garage, as the official page advises.

officialLots.access: Enclosed pedestrian bridge from the garage to Terminal 5

hours.notes: The official O’Hare parking pages do not publish lot opening hours.

officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-20. Payments are made to the cashier on exit; the official page lists cash and major credit cards. Rates include all taxes. officialLots.name: Economy Lot F (Multi-Modal Facility, covered)

officialLots.access: Free Airport Transit System (ATS) train to all terminals

hours.notes: The official O’Hare parking pages do not publish lot opening hours. The Economy page says the ATS and economy shuttle buses run every 5–10 minutes, 24 hours a day.

officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-20. Payments are made to the cashier on exit; the official page lists cash and major credit cards. Rates include all taxes. Parking over 30 days must be arranged in advance with the Parking Garage Office at (773) 686-7530 or the vehicle may be towed.
officialLots.visitNotes: The official page calls Lot F a long-term covered option and lists 24 Level II EV charging stations on Level 4 (Rows G–J). Reserved spaces are on Level 4.

officialLots.name: Economy Lots G and H
officialLots.area: Along Bessie Coleman Drive near Mannheim and Zemke Rd, north of Terminal 5
officialLots.access: Shuttle bus to the Multi-Modal Facility, then the free ATS train to all terminals

hours.notes: The official O’Hare parking pages do not publish lot opening hours. The Economy page says the ATS and economy shuttle buses run every 5–10 minutes, 24 hours a day. The two official pages describe Lot H’s location differently: the Economy page says the southeast corner of Mannheim and Zemke Rd, while the General Parking page says the northeast corner of Bessie Coleman and Coffey Rd.

officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-20. The official page calls Lot G the cheapest on-airport parking. The General Parking page marks Lot H as credit card only. Payments are made to the cashier on exit; the official page lists cash and major credit cards. Rates include all taxes. Parking over 30 days must be arranged in advance with the Parking Garage Office at (773) 686-7530 or the vehicle may be towed.
officialLots.visitNotes: The shuttle buses from Lots G and H make their last stop at the Multi-Modal Facility, where you board the ATS.

listings.visitNotes: The operator says no deposit is needed to reserve and payment is due at pickup. It recommends arriving 45–60 minutes before you want to be at the terminal.
listings.name: O’Hare Blue Sky Parking
listings.area: Schiller Park, about 5 minutes from the terminals per the operator

hours.notes: The operator’s FAQ says it operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with shuttle and valet staff around the clock.

listings.shuttle: Free 24/7 shuttle to all terminals. Average wait is 10–15 minutes depending on traffic, per the operator. On return, call (847) 678-9000 with your ticket number; pickup is at Terminal 2 Door #2A (middle lane) for Terminals 1–3 and Door #5E at Terminal 5.

sources.label: O’Hare Blue Sky Parking official site

listings.offersNotes: The operator lists EV charging as a 120V outlet, based on availability, and you bring your own charger.
listings.visitNotes: Wheelchair-accessible shuttles should be requested at least 24 hours ahead at 847-678-9234.
listings.name: PreFlight Airport Parking O’Hare
listings.area: Mannheim Rd, Schiller Park; a 7–15 minute shuttle ride per the operator

hours.notes: The operator lists customer service hours as open 24/7 but does not publish lot hours separately.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle every 7–10 minutes with real-time tracking, per the operator. From Terminals 1, 2, and 3 between midnight and 8:00 AM, call 847.678.9234 or text 224.330.9402 for pickup. From the International Terminal, call after customs and go to the lower level, outer curb, outside door 5E.

sources.label: PreFlight Airport Parking O’Hare location page

listings.visitNotes: The operator says it is family-owned and has served O’Hare since 1997, with fenced, well-lit lots. It suggests arriving 20 minutes before you want to be at the airport.
listings.name: Park N Jet O’Hare
listings.area: Mannheim Rd, Schiller Park; 7–10 minute drive to the terminals per the operator

hours.notes: The operator’s FAQ says it is open 24/7/365 and staffed 24/7.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttles to the domestic and international terminals; the ride is 7–10 minutes per the operator. Call or text when you land; your drop-off ticket lists the number. Drivers drop you off and pick you up at your vehicle.

listings.visitNotes: The site does not show a phone number in its page text; use the booking page or directions link.

listings.area: River St, Schiller Park; about 6 minutes from the airport per the operator

hours.notes: The operator advertises 24/7 security and access.

listings.shuttle: Complimentary shuttle 24/7/365, per the operator. See the shuttle instructions on its site.
